items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: here comes the blues like "Every Day" or "Diminuendo and Crescendo Blues," with -- that was Duke's biggest hit, after all, it is Paul Gonsalves was playing the blues.

ctx.x: I don't think that one should say that they're the best arrangements. What they really are is the thing that -- because they come out of the band, the phrases, fit the guys in the band and they can play them with the maximum feeling and swing, and that -- so the result is --

and, of course, the fact that they're very often blues is something else. I think it's extraordinary how everybody goes around doing these elaborate arrangements and everything, and here comes the blues like "Every Day" or "Diminuendo and Crescendo Blues," with -- that was Duke's biggest hit, after all, it is Paul Gonsalves was playing the blues.
